description: Round 7: four fixed course-only recipes, 20 outer CV fits and rank-based exports. No nested model retraining, no learned blend, no forced weak model family. Compare a preserved softmax HGB against autonomous OvR probability decomposition, a fixed 50:50 OvR/softmax architecture and native-categorical LightGBM. Target 0.92-0.94 is unverified and never a score cap.

experiment.label: round7_fast_ovr_native_categories
experiment.change_note: Remove slow Ordered CatBoost, SVC, teacher-weight retraining and nested search from the default run. Preserve HGB1600; compare four binary HGB heads, fixed OvR/softmax mixing and LightGBM categorical splitting. Rank fixed-recipe OOF scores and export the top two, including same-family winners. Add visible heartbeat logs and a data-free clean release verifier.
